Container.Name: Ombi Discord Router
Container.Overview: Companion service for MediaOps that receives Ombi webhook notifications and routes media request lifecycle updates into managed Discord Forum threads.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: ombi discord forum mediaops request webhook media server homelab
Container.Requires: Requires Ombi, a Discord Forum webhook, configured Forum tag IDs, and an existing user-defined Docker network shared with Ombi. MediaOps is required for live Forum tag synchronization and terminal thread locking.

Config.Name: Router Data
Config.Description: Persistent Ombi Discord Router request/thread index.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: IANA timezone used by the router for log timestamps.

Config.Name: Media Requests Webhook
Config.Description: Full Discord Forum webhook URL. Secret: the URL contains a Discord credential and must not be published.

Config.Name: Webhook Display Name
Config.Description: Display name used by the Discord webhook when posting request lifecycle updates.

Config.Name: Requested Status Tag ID
Config.Description: Discord Forum tag ID applied to newly submitted media requests that are waiting to be processed.

Config.Name: Processing Status Tag ID
Config.Description: Discord Forum tag ID used when a media request has been approved or is currently being processed.

Config.Name: Available Status Tag ID
Config.Description: Discord Forum tag ID used when the requested media is available on the configured media server. This is a terminal request state.

Config.Name: Failed Status Tag ID
Config.Description: Discord Forum tag ID used when processing or acquiring the requested media has failed. This is a terminal request state.

Config.Name: Denied Status Tag ID
Config.Description: Discord Forum tag ID used when a media request has been denied or rejected. This is a terminal request state.

Config.Name: Movie Media Tag ID
Config.Description: Discord Forum tag ID identifying a request as a movie. This media-type tag is preserved throughout the request lifecycle.

Config.Name: Series Media Tag ID
Config.Description: Discord Forum tag ID identifying a request as a TV series. This media-type tag is preserved throughout the request lifecycle.

Config.Name: Test Tag ID
Config.Description: Optional Discord Forum tag ID used only by Ombi's built-in Webhook Send test action. Test posts carry only this tag, are not indexed as media requests, and are ignored by the MediaOps request lifecycle.

Config.Name: Router Data Directory
Config.Description: Container path for the persistent request/thread index. Leave at /data for the packaged deployment.
